concerns.text: FR-006 requires the system to run the evaluation pipeline without GPU/CUDA, but no task explicitly verifies a CPU‑only execution environment or asserts that no GPU‑specific code is used.
FR-007 mandates pipeline execution to finish within 6 h on a CPU‑only runner, yet there is no task that measures the total runtime of the full‑dataset run (only a sample integration test T013).
SC-004 repeats the same missing‑runtime verification; no task records or asserts the end‑to‑end runtime bound for the complete dataset.
FR-009 calls for behavioral metrics (task completion, semantic coherence, interruption count) that are not derived from latency, but no task implements or validates these metrics.
SC-001 requires latency injection to modify *all* target scenarios without corruption; T006 only validates a single scenario, leaving full‑coverage verification uncovered.
The injection configuration schema is defined, but no task validates a concrete `injection.schema.yaml` instance against this contract.
The perturbation‑profile schema exists, yet no task creates or validates a perturbation‑profile JSON that conforms to this contract.
Related to SC-004, there is also no task that records memory usage to ensure the ≤ 7 GB RAM constraint is respected during full‑dataset execution.
